messages:
taylor: quick idea  thinking about a lightweight 'web onramp' for the browser SDK. expose a tiny JSON REST/POST at the edge that translates into our internal protobuf/gRPC streaming call. pros: very easy for frontend teams, no grpc-web runtime. cons: extra translate layer, telemetry/quotas mapping. anyone see major pitfall? :thinking_face:
jess: ergonomics are attractive. my main worry is Console visibility  if the gateway aggregates everything under one endpoint we lose per-model/route breakdown. also CORS/auth cookie flows need careful handling. :eyes:
omar: on quotas/billing: the gateway needs to attribute requests to tenant ids before aggregating. if we just bill by incoming path we can misattribute usage. we should require client creds->tenant resolution at edge and copy tenant id into translated headers.
sam: alternative is just teach frontends grpc-web and keep typed contracts/streams. grpc-web keeps us honest but adds deps. I'm leaning toward the shim if we can preserve headers/traces.
taylor: agree re: headers and tracing. proposal: gateway sets canonical headers that preserve original intent so telemetry/Console can split by model/route. sketch:
```
# browser POST body
{
  "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "model": "rw-llama-1",
  "input": "..."
}
# edge translates to gRPC and sets headers:
X-RW-ORIGINAL-ROUTE: /v1/chat/completions
X-RW-MODEL: rw-llama-1
X-RW-CLIENT-TYPE: web-sdk
X-RW-TENANT-ID: tenant_12345
```
sam: big question: where to count quota? at edge (fast) or runtime (accurate token cost)? counting at edge is simpler but can be gamed if translation/tokenization differs. maybe optimistic count at edge, then async reconcile from runtime. show mismatch alerts in Console.
omar: async reconcile is acceptable. we need a reconciliation job that emits metrics: quota_delta, corrected_events, and alerts if delta_rate > 0.5% for a tenant. also add a reconcile flag in route metadata.
deploy-bot: pipeline note: canary the shim behind feature flag. suggested rollout: route 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h observation windows. metrics to track: translate.success_rate, translate.latency_ms_p95, model.latency_ms_p95, quota_mismatch_rate.
jess: rollout SLOs: translation.latency p95 < 20ms, error rate < 0.2%, quota_mismatch_rate < 0.3%. if any breach -> pause rollout and auto-roll back to grpc-web path. also require traces show a translation span so Console trace view shows both edge and runtime timings.
taylor: i'll draft an RFC with header map, telemetry events (translate.started, translate.done, reconcile.correction), reconciliation job outline, and canary steps. will @jess @omar for review. thanks all. :sparkles:
